project.title: Pink Archaea responsible of discolorations on wall of heritage building
project.description: The study regards the pink alteration of the walls with drawings attributed to Michelangelo in the basement room of the Medici Chapel (Florence, Italy). Culture-based approaches combined with molecular and phylogenetic analyses revealed the pink pigmented Archaea, Halalkalikokus sp. as dominant, pointing its role in the wall discoloration.

samples: Metagenome or environmental sample from indoor metagenome
runs: 16S V3-V4 sequencing of microbiome associated with cultural heritage: wall pink discoloration
